questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: Regular script as the printed standard
questions.learningObjective: State why regular script became standard

stimulus.body: 请阅读以下材料：「Its clear, balanced strokes aided printing and teaching.」 四个选项中，只有一个能够从材料本身推出。

questions.stem: 本题的关键提示是“Regular script as the printed standard”。哪一项与材料一致？.

options.text: It used fewer strokes than any other script.
options.misconception: confuses standard status with stroke count

options.text: Its clear, balanced strokes aided printing and teaching.
It was the oldest script available.
It was only used in temples.

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: regular script is clear and balanced, so it prints and teaches well. On that basis "Its clear, balanced strokes aided printing and teaching" is the supported choice. Option A ("It used fewer strokes than any other script") fails because it confuses standard status with stroke count; Option C ("It was the oldest script available") fails because it attributes standard status to age; Option D ("It was only used in temples") fails because it limits regular script to temples.
